title: Receptionist
salary_text: £12.71 - £13.45 per hour (Weekly pay and regular work)
description:
Are you passionate about providing first-class customer service and looking for flexible temporary work?
We are currently recruiting Temporary Receptionists for a number of clients across Altrincham and the surrounding areas.

Whether you're looking for short-term work while searching for a permanent position, need flexibility around your existing commitments, or want to gain valuable experience with a variety of businesses, we'd love to hear from you.

We work with a wide range of employers, from local businesses to established corporate organisations, giving you the opportunity to build your Reception, Front of House, Customer Service and Administration experience.

What will you be doing as a Temporary Receptionist?
- Meeting and greeting visitors in a friendly and professional manner
- Answering and directing incoming telephone calls
- Dealing with general enquiries and providing excellent customer service
- Managing the reception area and ensuring visitors are looked after
- Supporting with general administration where required
- Liaising with colleagues and departments to ensure enquiries are dealt with efficiently
- Creating a welcoming and professional first impression for the business

We would LOVE to hear from you if you have the following skills and experience:
- Previous Reception, Front of House, Customer Service or Administration experience is preferred
- A genuine passion for providing first-class customer service
- Professional and presentable when working in a client-facing environment
- Excellent telephone manner and strong communication skills
- Confident dealing with a wide range of people
- Friendly, approachable and welcoming
- Well organised with good attention to detail
- Reliable and adaptable, with the ability to settle quickly into new environments
- Good IT skills and comfortable learning new systems

What will you get in return?
- 12.71- 13.45 per hour
- Weekly pay
- Full-time, part-time and occasional weekend opportunities
- Flexible temporary assignments
- Regular opportunities with a variety of local employers
- Valuable experience to add to your CV
- Potential opportunities for temporary work to lead to permanent positions

Why temp with Jobwise?

Temporary work is a great way to earn money while looking for your next permanent role, work around studies or family commitments, or gain experience across different businesses and working environments.
As a Jobwise temporary worker:
- We pay weekly
- You receive holiday pay, up to 28 days
- We can offer regular temporary work
- We have opportunities to suit different availability
- You'll gain experience across a variety of businesses and industries
- You'll develop new skills and strengthen your CV
- Temping can give you the opportunity to get your foot in the door with companies you may want to work for permanently

If you're friendly, professional, passionate about customer service and looking for flexible temporary Reception or Front of House work across Altrincham and surrounding areas, we'd LOVE to hear from you. Apply today!

Apply now by sending your CV. We aim to respond to all successful applications within 2 days. If you haven't been contacted within 2 days your application has been unsuccessful. Please check our website and apply directly for any other suitable positions you see. We apologise that we are unable to contact everyone in person and thank you for your interest. Jobwise Ltd is an employment agency and the details sent in your application may be stored on our secure database.

title: Scheduling Coordinator
description:
Scheduling Coordinator

Location: Altrincham
Salary: £30,000 £32,000
Hours: 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday (9am - 5:30pm)
Job Type: Permanent

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Scheduling Coordinator to join a busy and growing operations team based in Altrincham.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong background in scheduling, coordination, dispatch or logistics, ideally within a technical, engineering or field-service environment.

You will play a key role in coordinating a team of engineers, ensuring visits are scheduled efficiently, customers are kept informed and engineers have everything they need to complete their work successfully.

The role would suit someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is highly organised and enjoys problem-solving when priorities change throughout the day.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan and coordinate engineer schedules for installations, service visits, repairs and urgent callouts.
- Manage daily, weekly and monthly schedules, balancing workloads and engineer availability.
- Monitor live schedules and respond quickly to cancellations, delays, changing customer requirements and urgent requests.
- Maintain accurate job and scheduling information within Salesforce and internal systems.
- Coordinate with engineers to ensure they have the correct job information, site instructions, documentation and customer requirements.
- Track engineer movements and job progress, proactively identifying and escalating potential delays.
- Liaise with internal teams including Projects, Operations, Service Desk, Account Management and Finance.
- Act as a key point of contact for customers regarding scheduled visits and provide updates where arrangements change.
- Prepare and manage permits and RAMS documentation, ensuring information is accurate and compliant.
- Arrange accommodation and travel requirements for engineers where necessary.
- Review monthly timesheet information and investigate any discrepancies.
- Process fixed penalty fees where required.
- Maintain scheduling records, databases and reports.
- Support the wider team with identifying opportunities to improve scheduling and field-service processes.

About You

We are looking for someone who has previous experience in a scheduling, coordination, dispatch or logistics role, ideally where you have been responsible for managing multiple engineers, technicians, contractors or field-based employees.

You will ideally have:
- Proven experience working within a scheduling or coordination environment.
- Hands-on experience using Salesforce
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and remain calm under pressure.
- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach.
- Experience working with scheduling, tracking or operational systems.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
- The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.

Desirable Experience

Experience within a technical, engineering, installation, field service or project environment would be advantageous. Knowledge of permits, RAMS, compliance documentation or engineer site requirements would also be beneficial, although full training can be provided to the right candidate.

What's On Offer?
- Salary of £30,000 £32,000
- Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week
- Based in Altrincham
- Permanent position
- Opportunity to join a busy and established operations team
- Varied role with plenty of responsibility and opportunity to make an impact
